HOME SCIENCE MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Yeast Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Yeast Products.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Yeast Products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Yeast Products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Yeast Products.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Convenience Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Convenience Foods.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Convenience Foods.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Convenience Foods.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Convenience Foods.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pastry Making? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pastry Making.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Pastry Making.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pastry Making.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Pastry Making.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Careers in Food and Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Careers in Food and Nutrition.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Careers in Food and Nutrition.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li.

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
